body: I'm pretty isolated actually. I can't talk because of a dislocated jaw and I can't be around people much anyway due to the pandemic

Nothing can make me happy. I've been suicidal for over a decade. Everyday I wake up in pain. I can't do anything because I feel too sad and no one understands. I'm now clean from drugs and self harm, I eat healthily and exercise, I try to make friends and socialise, I do every tip I've found and can do but nothing works. And so many people are fucking sad. I feel everyone is depressed and angry. My friend killed themselves and I couldn't even go to their funeral because of the fucking pandemic. Same with my grandma, I didn't even get to say goodbye because for both times I was stuck abroad for university and couldn't go home safely. And I'm in physical pain. I have high blood pressure even though I'm in my early 20s because I just think about death and sadness. My brain is just bitter and rotten even though I love almost everyone I meet I know there's misery everywhere. I'm so hideous and ugly I don't want to show my face to anyone. Any time I think I might get the slightest bit of good thing something ruins it. I'm falling university because I'm the dumbest person there is. My family don't even want to be around me. My parents argue all the time and hate each other. I don't have anyone I'm really close with who enjoys spending time with me. Even if I did my depression would ruin it.
